summary: Event pages (/v1/events/page and the SDK's /v1/client/events) and the capabilities event cursor no longer hand out an event or cursor past the store index that client snapshots read at, so `fractal agents new` no longer misses a seat's readiness and waits out its timeout

replay.detail: No claim, projection or cache changes; nothing is replayed or rebuilt.

schema.detail: No table, index or storage version changes; the event page query gains an upper bound on store_index.

rules.detail: What is written and how it folds are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: GET /v1/events/page returns events, next_after and frontier (also in a cursor-gap error) only up to the published store index; GET /v1/client/events returns events and resume_cursor only up to it; the capabilities event-cursor is capped the same way. A commit whose writer has not yet published its index arrives on the next page, a moment later, instead of before a snapshot can show it. Clients need no change; the response shapes are the same.
